message: No detected input validation: The code performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on incoming data; it only drops known columns and removes NaN rows, which is preprocessing rather than validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: All data is read from local files or HTTP POST bodies with no checksum verification, signature checks, or authenticated source handling.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code only drops missing values and specific columns; there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious/poisoned samples.

No detected model integrity verification: Models are loaded via joblib.load() from local paths (e.g., 'models/saved_mlp_model.pkl') with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision performed before or after loading.

No detected label distribution validation: The code only removes missing data and drops specific columns; there is no class balance check, expected-label-set verification, or anomalous sample detection before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection is present anywhere in the training pipeline code.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard scikit-learn and joblib with no differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any adversarial stress test logic is present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While sklearn metrics (MAE, MSE, R2, explained variance) are imported, there is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independently verified metrics to guard against manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The only input check is verifying POST data is non-empty and using `allowed_file` for file extension validation; there are no shape, range, schema, or type checks on the data passed to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No code in the visible inference path checks model outputs for NaN values, out-of-range predictions, or any other sanity bounds before returning results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a numerical/tabular ML optimizer (not an LLM), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
